ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points A, B, and C are on the circle $\odot O$. If $\angle CAB=70^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle CAB=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC=2\angle CAB=\boxed{140^\circ}$
